column1: # The assembly has 19 chromosome-length scaffolds (2n = 38): 18 autosomes
# plus the X chromosome, with a separate Y and mitochondrion.
# The sex chromosomes and the mitochondrion are listed below. The autosome
# accessions are NOT filled in, because they must match the BAM header
# exactly and the order of accessions in the assembly cannot be assumed.
# Generate the complete file from your own BAM:
# Then open the result and check it: every chromosome-length scaffold should
# appear as an autosome, and nothing else should. Sequences that did not meet
# the criteria are listed at the end as comments, ready to be promoted.
# --prefix OZ keeps the human contigs out when a composite reference
# (marten + GRCh38) was used for competitive mapping.
